origin: Upstream historical ledger row v0213_to_v0214.jsonl:2644 commit 80c2696422a1e42551f9ab257dadc0a2bdaa529d introduced the no-process-global-PATHEXT contract; row :3250 commit 9eca7f388f71755293343dddd6ec4d9111d68fc4 is its formatter-only follow-up. final_observable_contract: A Windows MCP stdio server's configured PATHEXT must resolve its child executable without ever publishing that value into the Gateway process-wide environment. Child extension order must be honored; an explicitly empty child PATH must not search cwd; Windows NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath policy must suppress implicit cwd search.
